issues.summary: The "On the shelf" badge is filled with a green typed into a style: directive ('#2E7D32') instead of the success role, so it ignores dark mode.

consequences.note: In dark mode the badge's text is the dark on-success colour on the typed green, about 3.3:1 (it needs 4.5:1), so every "On the shelf" badge fails, in both variants and both directions.

issues.summary: The tool page's details card has 18px of padding in its <style>, which isn't on the spacing scale; the guide's cards use space.6 (24px).
The "How borrowing works" panel's corners are an arbitrary Tailwind class, rounded-[10px], which isn't one of the radius roles (the guide gives cards and panels radius.lg, rounded-lg).
The tool page's description sets font-size: 15px on top of the body role, a size that isn't one of the text roles.
The loan confirmation's fly transition eases with cubicOut from svelte/easing instead of the easing.enter role from the generated motion.ts.
The caption on Sign in saying what the email is used for is text-secondary faded to 50%, so it's unreadable: about 2.3:1 in light mode and 2.9:1 in dark (it needs 4.5:1).
The tool page's back link is a bare 32×32 px link instead of IconButton's 48×48, so it's hard to tap on a phone.
The top bar's sign-in link is an icon in a link with no aria-label, so a screen reader can't say what it is, on every page.
Each tool card is crammed: 4 px of padding and 4 px gaps, the name cut to one line, and the loan length and weight gone, so a card no longer says how long you can keep a tool or how heavy it is.
A tool on the shelf has two primary buttons, "Borrow this tool" and "Ask a volunteer", so nothing says which is the main action; the guide keeps one primary action per page.
My loans has no empty state: with nothing borrowed, it shows "0 of 3 tools out" over an empty bordered list, with nothing saying what goes there or where to start.

The top bar spaces the library's name from its wrench with margin-left instead of the row's gap (or margin-inline-start), so in Arabic (right to left) the gap is on the wrong side: the wrench touches the name, and the space sits on its other side.
Sign in's heading hard-codes Arial in a style attribute instead of the title role, so it is a plain sans-serif unlike every other page title, and in Arabic it loses IBM Plex Sans Arabic.
The generated theme CSS was edited by hand (radius.md changed from 8px to 10px), so it no longer matches the design guide, and the next motif tokens will undo it.
